children: Lazard Asset Management will be eager to see how bond markets will interpret Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh's commentary in the press conference on Wednesday, chief market strategist Ronald Temple says in a note. Lazard will also watch out for whether investors perceive Warsh to be consistently firm enough regarding fighting inflation, Temple says. The Fed is widely expected to raise interest rates by 25 basis points. Another aspect for Temple to watch is the Summary of Economic Projections to see how Federal Open Market Committee members have shifted their inflation and employment expectations given recent price increases in the energy sector.
